FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you build websites in Arabic and English?

Yes. We build mobile-friendly websites in both languages, with full right-to-left support for Arabic.

Can I edit the website content myself?

Yes. We hand over an easy-to-use dashboard for managing content, and train your team to run the site.

Do you connect stores to payment and shipping providers?

Yes. We build complete stores with payment gateways, shipping, and product and order management.

Will the website be optimized for search engines?

Yes. On every project we commit to search engine optimization, loading speed, mobile compatibility and analytics integration.

What happens after launch?

We provide a warranty and technical support after launch, and you can sign up for support & maintenance: reliable hosting, regular updates and backups.
